description: This Java source file defines the AcknowledgementAggregator class, which manages the collection and processing of acknowledgements within a specific context defined by entity and correlation IDs. It handles adding acknowledgement requests, receiving acknowledgements, checking completion status, and generating aggregated acknowledgement objects.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAggregator
classes.description: A thread-unsafe class used to aggregate acknowledgements and acknowledgement requests for a specific entity and correlation ID, handling timeout scenarios, and providing methods to add, process, and verify acknowledgements, as well as generate aggregated acknowledgement results.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory methods to create new instances of AcknowledgementAggregator with either EntityIdWithType or NamespacedEntityIdWithType.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with this aggregator.

methods.name: addAcknowledgementRequest
methods.description: Adds an acknowledgement request to the aggregator and initializes its timeout acknowledgement.

methods.name: addAcknowledgementRequests
methods.description: Adds multiple acknowledgement requests at once.

methods.name: addReceivedAcknowledgment
methods.description: Processes a received acknowledgement, updating internal state if it matches expected labels.

methods.name: receivedAllRequestedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Checks if all expected acknowledgements have been received.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Determines if all expected acknowledgements have been received successfully.

methods.name: getAggregatedAcknowledgements
methods.description: Constructs an Acknowledgements object encapsulating all received acknowledgements.
